Radiology Report
Date: 09/06/2026
Patient: Karry Bogisich, 76-year-old female

Examination: MRI thoracolumbar spine

Findings:
MRI thoracolumbar spine 09/06/2026: acute osteoporotic L3 compression fracture with bone marrow edema on STIR imaging.

Impression:
There is an acute osteoporotic compression fracture at the L3 vertebral body demonstrated by bone marrow edema on STIR sequences. No other acute abnormalities are identified in the thoracolumbar spine.

Recommendations:
Clinical correlation is advised. Further management should be determined by the referring physician based on this imaging finding.
